Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Dean Parisot’s father was “Jerome Menke” based on a single, likely erroneous/vandalized snapshot of Wikipedia and stated it as fact without corroboration. This confused the father-in-law’s surname (Menke) with the actual father. Reliable sources (and later checks) show the father is Aldo Parisot.
